description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed' which implements a token processing strategy for making HTML tokens well-formed by balancing tags, auto-closing tags, and correcting structural issues in HTML streams within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed
classes.description: A class implementing a strategy to process HTML tokens, ensuring correct nesting, auto-closing, and balancing of tags to produce well-formed HTML, used internally within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a list of tokens to make the HTML well-formed by balancing tags, auto-closing and correcting structures, configurable via parameters.

methods.name: processToken
methods.description: Handles the substitution and modification of individual tokens during processing, including token insertion, deletion, and replacement.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a token before the current token, adjusting the processing cursor accordingly.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current token from the stream.
